dedupe_keys.name: ensemble approach for flash flood forecasting a case study of the kinu river flood of 2015

description: Yuta Ishitsuka publishes preprocessing and visualisation scripts for an ensemble flash-flood forecast study of Japan’s 2015 Kinu River flood. Zenodo archives the code under an Other Open licence label with free public access, while the linked GitHub repository does not identify a specific code licence. The README describes transforming meteorological inputs to a land-surface model’s grid and decoding gtool output for a separate hydrodynamic model, then analysing the forecast results. These scripts can help compare flood-forcing and forecast workflows in a regional basin. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tool. A limitation is that the repository is not a stand-alone flood simulation engine; model outputs and observations are linked in an external archive whose access was not checked here. Script compatibility and reproduction of the published case remain unverified. No code or data archive was downloaded or run.
